alt: A huge LED-covered robot costume performer dances at an outdoor community festival with 'Irondale' visible on a sign in the background and a crowd of families watching
story: Irondale, Alabama rebranded its community festival as 'AI Love Irondale Day' to attract tech investment, faced an immediate online backlash calling it 'a pep rally for data centers,' and the mayor reversed course within days — but the festival's AI robot turned out to be a performer in an enormous LED-lit costume dancing in a parking lot.
why_funny: The town promised an AI-powered future and delivered a dude in a very large plastic robot suit doing the Achy Breaky Heart in Spanish.
